summary_md: ## How this run reached its result **Market backdrop:** The KSE-100 closed up 610 points at 177,382 (MAC-8), and the rupee was steady at 276.51 per dollar (MAC-4). The macro view is mixed: inflation reached 10.41% (MAC-6) and foreign investors repatriated $1.16 billion in July-October (MAC-11). Social mood is neutral. Over the last five sessions, advancers beat decliners on only two days. On 20 Nov, 227 stocks advanced and 259 declined, on traded value of about PKR 4.73 trillion, far above earlier days. Across the top 30, 16 rose, 10 were flat and 4 fell. **What drove the top 5:** - **PPL** (score 1.903): Q1 2027 EPS up 25.5%, and the close is above its 20-day average. - **EFERT** (1.811): 5-day return of +5.9% and urea price-hike news, but RSI 77.2 flags overbought. - **BAHL** (1.794): Q3 2026 EPS up 39.4%, but RSI 76.4 flags overbought. - **MEBL** (1.761): close above both 20-day and 50-day averages, plus SBP deposit-rule news. - **HBL** (1.702): short-term trend up, plus the same SBP deposit-rule news. **Where agents disagreed:** The file shows no visible split. All top 10 were won by the bull side, all are rated direction up, and risk is medium for every name. Conviction is medium for nine names and low for UBL. Caution flags on EFERT, BAHL, MEBL and MTL mark the main risks. The bear arguments are not in the file, so the size of any disagreement cannot be measured. **Missing data:** FIPI/LIPI foreign and local investor flow data was not supplied.
